description: This file defines the EmpDependent entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing dependents of employees including properties like name, relationship type, date of birth, and associations with an Employee entity.

classes.name: EmpDependent
classes.description: Entity class mapped to 'hs_hr_emp_dependents' table representing dependents of an employee with properties for name, relationship, date of birth, and associated employee.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmpDependentDecorator associated with this entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity associated as the dependent's owner.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated as the dependent's owner.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number of the dependent.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the dependent.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dependent.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Gets the relationship type (child, other) of the dependent.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type, ensuring it is either 'child' or 'other'.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Retrieves the date of birth of the dependent.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth of the dependent.
